Name: TID_MISSION_2_1_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I saw you talking to Alton. Did he make you run his errands?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_10_RECEIVING_MESSAGE

Name: TID_MISSION_2_11_RECEIVING_MESSAGE

Name: TID_MISSION_2_12_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: 42 you say? And my brother Roman sent you? All right, then. That means it's time to start a revolution. If you want to have a go against Labycore and its sycopants, stick around. We'll always have more work for soldiers.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_12_TASK_0

Name: TID_MISSION_2_13_OBJECTIVE

Name: TID_MISSION_2_13_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hahaha! Oh, that poor, poor thing. His is the first name I'll cross over from my client list.\nThis Queens contact list you downloaded will be very useful. Thanks.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_14
Text: Emilio and Charlie's Excellent Adventure

Name: TID_MISSION_2_14_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find Emilio in Market Square New Paris.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_14_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What? Me, caught? No no no, amigo. I'm too sneaky fer them Labycore pendejos. I'm here on business, ese, doin' stuff for that gun shop nearby.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_14_TASK_0

Text: Accidents Do Happen

Name: TID_MISSION_2_15_OBJECTIVE

Name: TID_MISSION_2_15_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks <PLAYER_NAME>! The Queens are one step closer to being out of business.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_15_TASK_0

Name: TID_MISSION_2_16_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Shh, pipe down! Are you out of your mind? Someone's gonna see us!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_16_TASK_0
Text: Mia Found

Name: TID_MISSION_2_17
Text: Three Bees

Name: TID_MISSION_2_17_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find Mia's Book in the Eastern Queens building in Lovens Park West.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_17_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Sweet, my book! You didn't read it, did you? Doesn't matter, it's all in code anyway\nNow, about that reward... I'm really... happy for what you did, y'know. I can make you happy, too...

Name: TID_MISSION_2_17_TASK_0

Name: TID_MISSION_2_18_TASK_0

Name: TID_MISSION_2_19
Text: This is Our City! Pt 1

Name: TID_MISSION_2_19_OBJECTIVE
Text: Get 3 key cards from the Hired Guns on Copenhagen Street.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_19_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Bien hecho, ese! With these key cards, we can open any door in the hospital! Get prepared, mira, we'll raid the place soon!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_19_TASK_0
Text: Key Cards Retrieved

Name: TID_MISSION_2_2
Text: Where's Wally?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_2_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find Wally in Container Storage.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_2_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: How did you find me? Oh. So, Angel sent you? Okay, then, let's get to business.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_20
Text: Labor Day

Name: TID_MISSION_2_20_OBJECTIVE
Text: Take a food package to four convicts at the prison camp at New London Street.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_20_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks. We can't rescue the prisoners yet because every prisoner is wearing a prison bracelet, and that bracelet will detonate if the convict tries leave the camp. Not many are willing to lose an arm and a leg just to get out of there.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_20_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Food... Thank you... I haven't eaten for days...

Name: TID_MISSION_2_20_TALK_TASK_1
Text: Water! Oh, bless you, friend! My throat was parched!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_20_TALK_TASK_2
Text: Whoever you are... You saved my life. Thank you.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_20_TALK_TASK_3
Text: Wha-- What? Food? No way! Gimme gimme gimme!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_20_TASK_0
Text: Convict Lars Fed

Name: TID_MISSION_2_20_TASK_1
Text: Convict Bert Fed

Text: This is Our City! Pt 2

Name: TID_MISSION_2_21_OBJECTIVE
Text: Turn off the hospital mainframe and eliminate all Hired Guns.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_21_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: This is one of the best things that's happened in this part of the city. Gracias, ese. Este seguro y puede Dios estar con usted.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_21_TASK_0

Name: TID_MISSION_2_22_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hahaha! Whee! I'm sure that one bastich's gonna miss that right arm, hehheh!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_22_TASK_0
Text: Propane Tanks Found

Name: TID_MISSION_2_22_TASK_1
Text: Food Stands Blown Up

Name: TID_MISSION_2_23
Text: What's 'How Do You Do?' in Voodoo?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_23_OBJECTIVE
Text: Interrogate the Sewer Voodoo informant on Amsterdam Street.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_23_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What the...? A chicken foot? What does that even mean? Oh, man, how creepy is *that*?\nI got goosebumps all over me!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_23_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Welcome ta where da mojo is, brah. Ere, mon. Take dis chicken foot. It mean we warn ya. Dis is the only warnin' we give ya, mon. Don't get in da way of loa, eh?\n\nNow go, mon. Irie. Peace be with ya.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_23_TASK_0
Text: Find Informant

Name: TID_MISSION_2_24
Text: The Exterminator

Name: TID_MISSION_2_24_OBJECTIVE
Text: Destroy three Power Boxes at New Peking Street. Eliminate the nearby Hooligans.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_24_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Amazing work back there. Let's hope this drives the message in.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_24_TASK_0
Text: Triggerhappy Hooligans Crippled

Name: TID_MISSION_2_24_TASK_1
Text: Haywire Hooligans Clipped

Name: TID_MISSION_2_24_TASK_2
Text: Electric Booths Destroyed

Name: TID_MISSION_2_25
Text: Meet Drush

Name: TID_MISSION_2_25_OBJECTIVE
Text: Meet Drush in the Berlin Street Hospital.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_25_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice to meet you. Claire said some nice things about you being a member of the resistance, helping those in need? Well, aren't you an angel from Heaven?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_25_TASK_0
Text: Talk to Drush

Name: TID_MISSION_2_26
Text: Destination Paradise

Name: TID_MISSION_2_26_OBJECTIVE
Text: You've done us all a huge favor in cleaning up Pearl Island and the Harbor! Maybe you can help a friend of mine? Paradise Island is lovely and warm, but De la Vega tells me there's blood on the sand...

Name: TID_MISSION_2_26_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Ahh! It's good to meet you, amigo! And how is the lovely River? Wait, don't tell me! 36-29-38, am I right?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_26_TASK_0
Text: Talk to Vega

Name: TID_MISSION_2_27
Text: Car Trouble

Name: TID_MISSION_2_27_OBJECTIVE
Text: Destroy the Eastern Queens car. Put down all Queens at Venice Bridge Street.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_27_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice work. Counterattack is sure to come, though. We better get prepared.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_27_TASK_0
Text: Eastern Queen Heavies Slain

Name: TID_MISSION_2_27_TASK_1
Text: Eastern Queens Slapped

Name: TID_MISSION_2_27_TASK_2
Text: Eastern Queen Maniacs Pacified

Name: TID_MISSION_2_27_TASK_3
Text: Queens' Car Torched

Name: TID_MISSION_2_28
Text: Do Not Pass Go

Name: TID_MISSION_2_28_OBJECTIVE
Text: Kill Grim Destroyer on New Naples Street.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_28_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Say what? Grim Destroyer was there, too? Well now. Call that a nice, fat bonus. Compared to him, all the other crooked coppers here look like playful puppies.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_29
Text: To Catch a Thief

Name: TID_MISSION_2_29_OBJECTIVE
Text: Our bar in down the harbor got robbed last night. The perps were two big scary dudes with braids, high as a kite. Never mind the cash but they took our ledgers with all the details of our financial operations. We need them back fast.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_29_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks for returning the data. Want a free beer for your troubles?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_29_TASK_0
Text: Account Book Retrieved

Name: TID_MISSION_2_3
Text: My Go-to Girl

Name: TID_MISSION_2_3_OBJECTIVE
Text: Thanks a bunch for all your help. If you're looking for more ways to aid us, you should talk to my go-to girl River.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_3_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hey there. I saw you inside speaking with Kaylee. I'm River - nice to meet you.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_30
Text: Venetian Hospitality

Name: TID_MISSION_2_30_OBJECTIVE
Text: A source told us that one of the Eastern Queens' top brass has arrived all the way from Europe. She's supposedly in town right now, using the alias Miss Amber.\nThis is the perfect opportunity to make the local Queens lose face - what if a VIP got killed while in their care?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_30_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Really? You found her and made her spit teeth? Well, what do you know, I was almost sure that this was nothing but a rumor.\nThis certainly makes things easier for a while here. While the Queens face the music for letting Miss Amber get killed on their watch, all we need to worry about is Labycore.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_31
Text: Meet Miranda

Name: TID_MISSION_2_31_OBJECTIVE
Text: Well done, <PLAYER_NAME>! Listen, my sister Miranda wants to meet you. She's on the other side of town, just go that way.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_31_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Show me Grant's face, and I'm yours for half an hour.\nOh, what? You are here to help?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_31_TASK_0
Text: Talk to Miranda

Name: TID_MISSION_2_32
Text: Meet Raquel

Name: TID_MISSION_2_32_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hey, thanks again. I got no more jobs lined up at the moment, but if you talk to my friend Raquel, she might have something for you.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_32_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You made it through in one piece, it seems. Well, good for you - we all are trapped here. This small area is all we control in this area. Venture out, and you're on your own.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_32_TASK_0
Text: Find Raquel

Name: TID_MISSION_2_33
Text: Meet Meryl

Name: TID_MISSION_2_33_OBJECTIVE
Text: Could you go find Meryl and tell her she can come home now?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_33_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks, <PLAYER_NAME>.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_34
Text: Wash Away The Dirt

Name: TID_MISSION_2_34_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hey, you're the guy who's been taking out all the mobsters around here! You don't need to know my name, just that I pay top dollar to anyone who cleans up the garbage. I have a job for you...

Name: TID_MISSION_2_34_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great job. Those guys won't be running any racket ever again.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_35
Text: Bullet-Tooth

Name: TID_MISSION_2_35_FINISHED_SOCIAL_NETWORK_POST
Text: Big Bad Bullet-Tooth took a bath in a hail of hot lead! You can thank me later.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_35_OBJECTIVE
Text: This is a special mission, need-to-know and all that cool stuff. I want you to kill Bullet-Tooth and retrieve a Data Disc from one of his minions.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_35_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great job, kid! This super secret data is really cool to have. Now if we could just unencrypt it somehow...

Name: TID_MISSION_2_35_TASK_0
Text: Pulverize Bullet-Tooth

Name: TID_MISSION_2_35_TASK_1
Text: Recover Intel

Name: TID_MISSION_2_36
Text: Be Prepared

Name: TID_MISSION_2_36_OBJECTIVE
Text: Our scout Maria has been keeping an eye on the Mad Dogs. She reported increased activity in their nearby compound. Go check it out!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_36_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You'd never make a scout sniper, but at least you can fight.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_36_TALK_TASK_0
Text: You fool, you led the Dogs straight to my location. Here they come!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_36_TASK_0
Text: Protect Maria

Name: TID_MISSION_2_37
Text: Into Thin Air

Name: TID_MISSION_2_37_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Mad Dogs in this area are toting some high tech guns I've never seen before. I killed a patrol and tried to grab their weapons, but they just vanished in a puff of smoke. Maybe you'll have better luck with a whole crate of them?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_37_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: At least these guns stay solid, though I wouldn't dare touch them before we find out more about this tech.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_37_TASK_0
Text: Acquire Vaporware weapons

Name: TID_MISSION_2_38
Text: Hot Air by Design

Name: TID_MISSION_2_38_OBJECTIVE
Text: We might have hit the jackpot. Some Labycore Suits with briefcases walked into that warehouse. I'm calling a target of opportunity here.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_38_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good work, that egghead won't be coming up with new ways to kill us. I'll pass the schematics along to our people.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_38_TASK_0
Text: Stop Research

Name: TID_MISSION_2_38_TASK_1
Text: Download Weapon Schematics

Name: TID_MISSION_2_39
Text: Vaporware is the New Black

Name: TID_MISSION_2_39_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Vaporware guns in the crate are disassembled. See if you can't find a few complete rifles lying around. I'm guessing that newly assembled weapons don't yet have their anti-theft system activated, if that's what causes these guns to vaporize.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_39_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: All right, I guess you're not totally useless. Complete working units and gun parts together give our gunsmiths something to work with.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_39_TASK_0
Text: Acquire Vaporware Weapons

Name: TID_MISSION_2_4
Text: Playing it Safe

Name: TID_MISSION_2_4_OBJECTIVE
Text: Find Dawn's Data Discs near the Harbor Entrance's weapon shop.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_4_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks. Here's your reward. Go buy yourself something pretty.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_40
Text: Nick The Scientist

Name: TID_MISSION_2_40_OBJECTIVE
Text: We still need someone to make some sense of the weapon schematics. Perhaps we could... persuade... one of Rogue Scientists to help us out.\nGo find whoever's in charge of the lab in Warehouse #10, and make him an offer.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_40_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hey, wait, I'll cooperate! Look, you got it all wrong. I've been kidnapped!\nUntil a couple of months ago, I was working at the MIT optical camouflage lab, and I just... woke up here one morning.\nYou don't have to tell me twice to stop working for these kidnappers. In fact, let's do one better...

Name: TID_MISSION_2_40_TASK_0
Text: Lean on Scientist

Name: TID_MISSION_2_41
Text: Shut Down the Factory

Name: TID_MISSION_2_41_OBJECTIVE
Text: There's another suspicious warehouse with an awful lot of goons milling around it. I'd bet my ass that place is connected to these Vapor weapons. Shut it down.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_41_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great work. That should put the Dogs back to Stone Age where they belong.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_41_TASK_0
Text: Research Stopped

Name: TID_MISSION_2_41_TASK_1
Text: Server Shut Down

Name: TID_MISSION_2_41_TASK_2
Text: Mainframe Shut Down

Name: TID_MISSION_2_42
Text: Pulling the Plug

Name: TID_MISSION_2_42_OBJECTIVE
Text: Here's my keycard. Use it to access the databanks and wipe the lot. That should set Labycore back a quite a bit.\nUnfortunately, I can't tell you what the vaporware tech actually was. I only worked on the interface module with biometric security.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_42_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Huh. So Labycore kidnapped a scientist from the mainland and forced him to work on their weapons program. We must investigate this further, maybe there are other researchers like Nick, looking for a way out...

Name: TID_MISSION_2_42_TASK_0
Text: Deactivate Missiles

Name: TID_MISSION_2_43
Text: Talk to Rubert

Name: TID_MISSION_2_43_OBJECTIVE
Text: Talk to Rubert in Drug Farm West

Name: TID_MISSION_2_43_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: So. You must be the miracle maker Holden promised he'd send over? Good. Let's get crackin'.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_44
Text: Lay of the Land

Name: TID_MISSION_2_44_OBJECTIVE
Text: Is the smell bothering you? The Mad Dogs use raw sewage for manure on their little green patch. Think about that before taking your next W.U.Z.Z. hit! Anyway, one of our guys went to have a chat with the gardener and hasn't come back. Find out what's up.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_44_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Whoa, no need for violence! I just work here. I'll tell you everything I know.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_45
Text: OLDIE

Name: TID_MISSION_2_46
Text: Get Back to River

Name: TID_MISSION_2_46_OBJECTIVE
Text: The boss needs to know about Labycore's latest scheme ASAP. I'll keep watching the warehouses, you go to River and report in.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_46_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Interesting. The Resistance has suspected that Labycore does some shenanigans on the mainland, but this is the first we hear about a kidnapped scientist. Perhaps our new friend Nick can help us find others like him.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_46_TASK_0
Text: Talk to River

Name: TID_MISSION_2_47
Text: Gun Delivery

Name: TID_MISSION_2_47_OBJECTIVE
Text: We've been bombarded by Dreamlab's marketing crap for months. Now they finally give us something useful! All we need is authorized citizens to cash in these coupons. I have an idea...

Name: TID_MISSION_2_47_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I can't believe it! 50% off? This is an AMAZING offer!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_48
Text: Repel the Raiders

Name: TID_MISSION_2_48_OBJECTIVE
Text: Mad Dogs gang members are sniffing around in the neighborhood, stealing our medical supplies.\n\nOpen a can of whoop ass on the Mad Dogs in Rebel Camp.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_48_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great job! The Dockers - one of the Resistance gangs - will be happy to hear what you did. They hate the Mad Dogs with passion - many of the Dogs used to run with the Dockers, but when the times got rough, they sold out and joined the enemy. The Dockers are understandably a bit sore about that.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_49
Text: Super Sleuth

Name: TID_MISSION_2_49_OBJECTIVE
Text: I wonder what's going on at the super secret research lab! Trucks have been coming in day and night. Look into it, would you? I'll make it worth your while.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_49_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > McFly: Holy damn!! I knew the Labycore were up to no good, but I had no idea it was that bad.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_5
Text: Just a Small Favor

Name: TID_MISSION_2_5_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Dockers smuggled some goodies for me from the outside world, but I can't go get the package myself. Could you help me out please?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_5_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Sweet! Would've been a shame to see these fall into the hands of them Dumb Mutts. They have no appreciation for fine things like these anyway.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_50
Text: Access Granted

Name: TID_MISSION_2_50_OBJECTIVE
Text: Acces Denied.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_50_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Access Granted.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_51
Text: Rescue Refugees

Name: TID_MISSION_2_51_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Tollman: Look, you can't leave those poor people to suffer. Do something about it!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_51_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Tollman: Ohh yeah. You're some kind of hero.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_51_TASK_0
Text: Free Test Subjects

Name: TID_MISSION_2_52
Text: Supplies Are Your Friend

Name: TID_MISSION_2_52_OBJECTIVE
Text: Sign up for duty in Rebel Camp hangar and get paid when your Credibility score is 4. Buy supplies.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_52_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Splendid! Here's your fifty dollars. Check what our vendors have for sale.\nI'd recommend buying medkits or grenades from the vendor by the beds.\nAs a rule of thumb, we sell equipment real cheap to trusted members of the Resistance. Credibility equals trust.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_53
Text: After These Messages

Name: TID_MISSION_2_53_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Tollman: Listen! This marketing research data shows that Labycore is about to start a huge promotion selling discounted guns to Dawnbreak citizens.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_53_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Tollman: What the heck? \qGuns for everyone, keep your family safe at cut rates?\q Where do they come up with this crap!?

Name: TID_MISSION_2_53_TASK_0
Text: Deliver Marketing Dossier

Name: TID_MISSION_2_54
Text: Printing Money

Name: TID_MISSION_2_54_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Completed coupons with citizen_dna imprint: 1\n\n> Number of coupons without citizen_dna imprint: 300

Name: TID_MISSION_2_54_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: What does it say here? \qSPECIAL PROMOTION, Protect your family with Labytech Arms!\q

Name: TID_MISSION_2_54_TASK_0
Text: Collect sample case

Name: TID_MISSION_2_55
Text: Speak with Adelle

Name: TID_MISSION_2_55_OBJECTIVE
Text: Adelle has been scouting the Dry Dock based on Nick's information. She's found something, go check it out.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_55_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks for coming. I found the Mad Dog who's running the show around here.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_56
Text: Kill Kingpin

Name: TID_MISSION_2_56_OBJECTIVE
Text: Kingpin is the guy who's been organizing the Mad Dogs in this area. All the grief they've caused lately is because of this bastard here. You've knocked over a lot of Mad Dog pawns to be sure, but if we want to win the game you need to checkmate the King.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_56_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Cut off the head and the body will fall down. Most Mad Dogs are too stupid to tie their own shoelaces. With Kingpin out of the picture, we can breathe and move a little easier around here.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_56_TASK_0
Text: Kill Kingpin

Name: TID_MISSION_2_57
Text: Checkpoint

Text: Pheromones

Name: TID_MISSION_2_8_RECEIVING_MESSAGE

Name: TID_MISSION_2_108_OBJECTIVE
Text: Listen carefully! We have a new threat in Dawnbreak and for that reason it's time to upgrade your weapon with special items. Go talk to Tollman.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_108_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: We need to deal more damage to kill those zombies roaming on our streets. Please take these plans for extra damage.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_108_TASK_0
Text: Get Damage Boost Plans

Name: TID_MISSION_2_111_OBJECTIVE
Text: Here we go. Fully functional antenna relay. Dawnbreak Avenue has the tallest buildings. Go there and plug this into the cables.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_111_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hello world! You can hear me! Let's see those Labycore nasties put a spin on this! Here you go, for services rendered!\n

Name: TID_MISSION_2_111_TASK_0
Text: Plug Relay at Dawnbreak Avenue

Name: TID_MISSION_2_112_OBJECTIVE
Text: First transmissions are coming in... The artificial island we are on is sinking! Fast. I know the local survivors have a Labycore engineer with them. Go and find him.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_112_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: IzaK sent me a straggler? This is for your trouble but we'll see if you really are tough enough for the Avenue.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_2_112_TASK_0
Text: Talk to Engineer Eddie

Name: TID_MISSION_2_113_OBJECTIVE
Text: We are running out of medical supplies. The delivery never got this far due to zombie invasion. Go find us some and I will help you.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_113_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That's a start. So yeah, I used to work for Labycore but soon noticed the corruption behind and have now jumped to the Resistance.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_113_TASK_0
Text: Find Medical Boxes

Name: TID_MISSION_2_114_OBJECTIVE
Text: It is true that the island is sinking and we need to make it stop. Find me the island blueprints from the Old Labycore Office down the street.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_2_114_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good. You really can deliver! I have to go study these now but there are other jobs you can do.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_114
Text: Waterline

Name: TID_MISSION_2_114_TASK_0
Text: Find Island Blueprints

Name: TID_MISSION_2_115_OBJECTIVE
Text: The Mad Dogs gang has stolen our stock of Zombie Rot medicine. I need you to bring back our meds and make sure they don't do it again.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_115_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! For lives saved and lives yet to be saved. The patients wanted me to give you this.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_115
Text: Bad Apples

Name: TID_MISSION_2_115_TASK_0
Text: Loot medicine from Mad Dog Brawlers

Name: TID_MISSION_2_116_OBJECTIVE
Text: We sink because Labycore cut power to the ballast pumps. Pumps are located in the subway. Talk to Stan who knows more about the subway.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_116_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Yep. Nellie has been talking about moving. I need you to keep the zombies at bay. Let's go.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_116_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Oh the subway... Yes I know a thing or two about it.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_116
Text: Housing Crisis

Name: TID_MISSION_2_116_TASK_0
Text: Talk to Stan

Name: TID_MISSION_2_108
Text: Make More Damage 2

Name: TID_MISSION_2_109
Text: Instant Crafting 2

Name: TID_MISSION_2_117_OBJECTIVE
Text: Go talk to Foote and see for yourself! The resistance has found blueprints for latest Labycore innovation from the ruins of L.A.R.P.U.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_117_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: It's called a \qBlink\q. Combat booster. Rumors say that it moves you next to your target in a blink of an eye.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_117_TASK_0
Text: Talk to Foote to get Plans

Name: TID_MISSION_2_117
Text: Yet Another Booster

Name: TID_MISSION_2_102_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Let's go to make sure that Michaela rests in peace.

Name: TID_MISSION_2_118_OBJECTIVE
Text: I will give you the crafting plans for Power Plant Key if you do me a favor and take down Sentinel, the final guardian at Dawnbreak Square. That bot has done so much harm to me and my friends...

Name: TID_MISSION_2_118_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thank you! Here is the key to the Power Plant. If Sentinel was a bit outdated model, Labycore has the upgraded ones guarding the power plant so... Good luck!

Name: TID_MISSION_2_118_TASK_0
Text: Take Down Sentinel

Name: TID_MISSION_2_118
Text: Key to Power Plant
